{{Aries}}
Aries 12 is the 124th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 12th day of Aries, and it is a Friday. It corresponds to ISO week 18, weekday 5.

Its informal Japanese name is 5宮12日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 124|Chapter 124]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152144}}.
